title: The Space Ship
lines: Jane and Ben make a box space ship.
They tape on a nose and a face.
"This is space," said Jane, and they hop in.
Then Grace runs up. "Is there a place?"
The box is small. There is no space.
Ben sticks a small box on with tape.
"That is a nice place, Grace," said Jane.
Grace, Jane and Ben race to space.

questions.ask: What do Jane and Ben use to make the ship?
questions.listenFor: A big box and tape. Lines one and two say it.

questions.ask: What was the problem when Grace ran up?
questions.listenFor: The box was small, so there was no space for her. Line five says it. This is the middle of the story.

questions.ask: Where would you fly a box ship? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason is right. This one is just for talking.
